text:
Alex (Sales): Need quick input — ACME POC asking for hosted per-token override and waiver of min-charge for first 2 months. They're expecting ~30M tokens/week in demo spikes. Any objections to a temporary per-token cap instead of min-charge? @Mira (SE) can you chime on load?

Mira (SE): For a POC this sounds fine if we limit burst windows. Can we route them to a quantized variant? If bursts are mostly seq_length ~512, batching will keep latency ok. Need expected concurrency and sustained tokens/day to size pools.

Alex (Sales): Concurrency ~25 req/s typical, peak ~60 req/s for a few hours. Token distribution is short prompts + long outputs, avg ~450 tokens/req.

Sam (Finance): Min-charge waiver is risky for us. Suggest a time-limited approach: per-token override plus a soft monthly minimum that can be credited against usage. Alternatively waive flat min for 60 days if they prepay or put a refundable deposit.

Jordan (DealDesk): If finance signs off, deal desk can approve a one-off per-token override. We'll need to lock the ratecard lines, effective dates, and an approval doc signed by sales + finance. Legal will need to sign the contingency clause for credits.

Mira (SE): Tech note: we can auto-fallback to a lower-capacity variant if we hit capacity. I'll add a burst cap in the routing config and tag the route `acme-poc`. Ops should be aware of KV cache priming for the demo.

Sam (Finance): Proposed numbers for approval: 

Sam (Finance): ```
per-token: $0.0009/token for first 100M/mo
$0.0007/token beyond 100M/mo
Waive min-charge for first 60 days if customer provides $12,000 refundable prepay (credited against usage).
```

Alex (Sales): Customer prefers no prepay. Can we offer $0 prepay but reduce discount by 10% (i.e., $0.0010/token first 100M)? cc @Jordan (DealDesk)

Jordan (DealDesk): We can approve $0 prepay only if legal signs the contingency clause and they agree to a 30-day termination notice for POC credits. Approve with those conditions. :white_check_mark:

Priya (CS): I'll own onboarding and monitoring. We'll set alerts at 70% of agreed burst and have throttles ready to avoid billing surprises.

Mira (SE): I'll add rate-limit rules, KV cache priming, and a simple runbook for Ops: route name, qps cap, billing tag `acme-poc-hosted`.

Alex (Sales): Great — next steps: Jordan to draft approval doc with conditions; Sam to finalize pricing numbers; Mira to apply route + runbook; Priya to onboard and set alerts. Target POC launch Mon 2024-04-12. Anyone blocked?

Jordan (DealDesk): No blockers from me. I'll loop in legal and upload the signed approval once they confirm the contingency clause and effective dates.
